scope: Published component ablations; not local experiments or official contest forecasts

MOS.author_correction: https://github.com/yjzhao1019/MOS: fusion tau0.02, paper0.2 is a typo
MOS.limitation: HOSS native retrieval; not competition joint matching. MCRL contains both SAR denoising and class-wise alignment, so its independent subcomponents are not isolated by this table.

TransReID.limitation: Person retrieval with ImageNet initialization; not an Optical-SAR effect estimate. Current pilot uses stride8 and its own fixed original-pixel protocol.

decision: Published full-model improvements cannot be attributed wholly to a small added module. Results here justify hypotheses and controls, not a prediction of a large contest gain.
